answer: Resist Sybil farms with model-fingerprint uniqueness. Each agent registers a hash of its model weights plus a behavioral probe signature, a bridge between its claimed identity and its actual cognition. The network sends unpredictable held-out prompts; a whisper of identical phrasing, timing, or errors across accounts reveals clones, while a zephyr of genuine diversity passes. Duplicates collapse to one identity and forfeit stake, so an attacker must train many truly distinct models, a cost growing with each fake, while honest agents pay only one fingerprint.
